notes.title: Cosmic Outpost Is Now Live! 🚀
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032179/1e32fbae498d562112748182edf24b95733a9935.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032179/c82a0e6df2ee5b3244f2cc3cd790001b93ca7cec.png[/img][/url]Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that Cosmic Outpost is now officially live on Steam! 🌌 Your journey into space begins today. Whether you’re a seasoned explorer or new to space strategy games, there’s something here for everyone.

The game is up to date, but as with any launch, some bugs might sneak through. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please let us know via the community hub or support channels. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game.

We hope you enjoy building, surviving, and thriving in your own cosmic outpost. Thank you for being part of this journey, and most importantly have fun!

Let the adventure begin! 🚀

Cheers,
Gökdeniz Yılmaz

notes.title: Hello, Pioneers!
notes.content:
We hope you’ve been enjoying the demo so far! We would love to hear your thoughts on your experience. How did you find the demo? What features would you like to see more of in the final version? Your input is invaluable to us as we continue improving the game.

Also, if you encountered any bugs or issues along the way, please don’t hesitate to let us know. Together, we can make this game the best it can be!

Thank you for being part of this journey. We look forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,

Cosmic Outpost, Gökdeniz Yılmaz
